pia_fit.method: 1.0th percentile of excitatory soma y per 100-µm (x,z) grid cell, hole-filled + gaussian-smoothed, minus 90 µm nominal L1 thickness

layers.note: Layers are depth bands below a pia PROXY, anchored on landmarks of the smoothed excitatory-soma density (saved in node_ann.npz as density_centers/density_smoothed) via half-height flank crossings. Display annotation, not ground truth; never touches the optimizer or the oracle.

spectral.weights: log1p of undirected collapsed synapse counts
